description: Search UNESCO Global Geoparks by keyword, country, designation year range, transnational status, or distance from a point. Every keyword must appear at the start of a word in the geopark's name, introduction, description, or account of how it sustains local communities, and name matches rank first. A country is an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 code and matches every geopark it takes part in, transnational geoparks included. Geoparks UNESCO recognized before the Global Geopark label existed are dated 2015, the year it was created. Results page with next_cursor and carry facet counts over the whole match.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 code, any case (FR, FRA). Matches every geopark the country takes part in, transnational geoparks included. For a country name, look up its code with unesco_list_reference (topic countries).

cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor from the previous call's next_cursor. Pass it with the same filters and sort to fetch the next page.

include_description.description: Set false to leave each row's introduction out of the response (default true); unesco_get_geopark returns it. Which geoparks match, their order, and matched_in are unchanged.

near.description: Only geoparks within radius_km of this point. Every geopark has one point, which the distance measures.

latitude.description: Latitude of the point, in decimal degrees (−90 to 90).

longitude.description: Longitude of the point, in decimal degrees (−180 to 180).

radius_km.description: Search radius in kilometres (up to 5000, default 100).

query.description: Keywords; every word must match the start of a word in the geopark's name, introduction, description, or account of sustaining local communities. Case, accents, and punctuation are ignored, so the query must contain at least one letter or digit and at most 16 distinct words; no phrases, operators, or fuzzy matching. For a landform, use a word such as volcanic, karst, or fossil.

sort.description: Result order. Default: relevance when query is set, else distance when near is set, else name. relevance needs query; distance needs near. area_largest orders by recorded area.

transnational.description: true: only geoparks spanning more than one country. false: only single-country geoparks.

name: unesco_search_geoparks

applied_filters.description: The filters and sort as the server applied them.

code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code the country input resolved to.

sort.description: The sort applied (resolved default when none was given).

cap.description: The page size (limit) that was applied.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unknown_country`: country is not a recognized ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 code, such as a country name or an unassigned code. `invalid_year_range`: designated_from is later than designated_to. `sort_needs_input`: sort relevance without query, or sort distance without near. `cursor_mismatch`: cursor was issued for different filters or sort, or for an earlier data snapshot. `invalid_cursor`: cursor is malformed, or its offset or limit is not a non-negative whole number. `snapshot_unavailable`: No geopark snapshot has loaded yet and the Data Hub is unreachable. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

facets.description: Facet counts over the whole match, not just this page.

top_countries.description: Top 10 countries; a transnational geopark counts for each of its countries.

count.description: Matching geoparks the country takes part in.

countries.description: Country display names aligned with country_codes.

country_codes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes of the geopark's countries; a transnational geopark lists each.

designation_year.description: Designation year; geoparks UNESCO recognized before the Global Geopark label existed are dated 2015, the year it was created.

distance_km.description: Distance from the near point in km (present when near is set).

introduction.description: UNESCO's introduction to the geopark; omitted from every row when include_description is false.

matched_in.description: The first field tier by which every query word had matched (present when query is set); description covers the description and the account of sustaining local communities.

population.description: Resident population, as recorded; absent when UNESCO records none, and 0 can mean unreported.

transnational.description: True when the geopark spans more than one country.

ugg_id.description: UNESCO Global Geopark id; pass to unesco_get_geopark for the full record.

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor, with the same filters and sort, to fetch the next page. Present when more results remain.

notice.description: Guidance on the result: why nothing matched, caveats, or how to continue paging.

shown.description: Number of results on this page.

sources.description: Datasets this response was built from.

attribution.description: Credit line to reproduce with the data.

data_as_of.description: Dataset's data_processed timestamp (ISO 8601) from the loaded snapshot.

license.description: Dataset license from the dataset metadata ('CC BY-SA 4.0').

truncated.description: True when more results remain beyond this page.

title: Search UNESCO Global Geoparks
